name: What should homeowners prepare before the tile installation crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before the tile installation crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an installer arrives, clear all furniture, appliances, and personal items from the project space, and determine clear access paths through your home. Disclose any known plumbing leaks, uneven subflooring, or prior settlement issues so the team can bring appropriate leveling compounds and framing supplies. It is helpful to confirm your desired layout pattern, grout color, and transition strips in advance. Ensure that pets are secured in a separate area and that dust containment barriers can be set up around adjoining doorways.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all personal belongings and furniture from the area, confirm tile layout and grout selections, and identify any known subfloor or plumbing issues in advance.
